description: This file defines various data structures related to agent management, execution tracking, memory management, workflow orchestration, and status monitoring within a distributed AI agent system. It establishes types for agent nodes, executions, memory, workflows, status reports, and related metadata, serving as a foundational schema for a complex orchestrated environment.

classes.name: AgentExecution
classes.description: Represents a single execution instance of a reasoner or skill, including input/output data, metadata, status, and timestamps.

classes.name: ExecutionMetadata
classes.description: Holds extensible metadata related to an agent execution, such as cost, performance, and compliance.

classes.name: CostMetadata
classes.description: Metadata related to the costs incurred during an agent execution.

classes.name: ABTestMetadata
classes.description: Contains information about A/B testing variants for an execution.

classes.name: ModelMetadata
classes.description: Information about the model used in an execution, including name, version, provider, and parameters.

classes.name: ComplianceMetadata
classes.description: Auditing and regulatory compliance metadata.

classes.name: PerformanceMetadata
classes.description: Performance metrics such as queue time, cache hits, and retries.

classes.name: Memory
classes.description: Represents a stored piece of memory with scope, data, and metadata.

classes.name: MemoryMetadata
classes.description: Metadata associated with a memory object, including encryption and access controls.

classes.name: VectorRecord
classes.description: Stores embedding vectors with associated metadata.

classes.name: VectorSearchResult
classes.description: Represents a result from vector similarity search.

classes.name: EncryptionMetadata
classes.description: Metadata related to data encryption.

classes.name: ReplicationMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for data replication details.

classes.name: AnalyticsMetadata
classes.description: Analytics related metadata for memory accesses.

classes.name: AccessControlMetadata
classes.description: Access control policies metadata.

classes.name: AgentNode
classes.description: Represents a registered agent node with configuration, status, and features.

classes.name: CallbackDiscoveryInfo
classes.description: Contains info on how an agent's callback URL was resolved.

classes.name: CallbackTestResult
classes.description: Results of probing a callback URL.

classes.name: ReasonerDefinition
classes.description: Defines a reasoner provided by the agent node, including schemas and memory config.

classes.name: SkillDefinition
classes.description: Defines a skill provided by the agent node.

classes.name: MemoryConfig
classes.description: Configuration for agent memory behavior.

classes.name: CommunicationConfig
classes.description: Communication protocols supported by an agent.

classes.name: HealthStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of agent health states.

classes.name: AgentLifecycleStatus
classes.description: Enum for agent lifecycle states.

classes.name: AgentStatus
classes.description: Unified model capturing agent's overall status, health, lifecycle, and transitions.

classes.name: AgentState
classes.description: Primary state of an agent (active, inactive, starting, stopping).

classes.name: MCPStatusInfo
classes.description: Status information about MCP server fleet.

classes.name: StateTransition
classes.description: Represents an ongoing transition between agent states.

classes.name: StatusSource
classes.description: Indicates the origin of a status update.

classes.name: AgentStatusUpdate
classes.description: Represents a request to update agent status.

classes.name: AgentFeatures
classes.description: Feature flags for agent capabilities.

classes.name: AgentMetadata
classes.description: Extensible metadata for agent nodes.

classes.name: DeploymentMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for deployment environment and platform.

classes.name: AgentPerformanceMetadata
classes.description: Performance metrics metadata for agents.

classes.name: ExecutionFilters
classes.description: Filters for querying agent executions.

classes.name: AgentFilters
classes.description: Filters for agent nodes.

classes.name: EventFilter
classes.description: Filters for memory events.

classes.name: MemoryChangeEvent
classes.description: Event object for memory modifications.

classes.name: EventMetadata
classes.description: Contextual metadata for memory events.

classes.name: DistributedLock
classes.description: Lock object for distributed coordination.

classes.name: LockEvent
classes.description: Event related to distributed lock actions.

classes.name: WorkflowExecution
classes.description: Tracks execution of a workflow, including hierarchy and timestamps.

classes.name: WorkflowExecutionEvent
classes.description: Immutable event recording execution lifecycle changes.

classes.name: WorkflowRunEvent
classes.description: Records events at the overall workflow run level.

classes.name: ExecutionWebhookEvent
classes.description: Outbound webhook delivery attempt record.

classes.name: WorkflowRun
classes.description: Represents a workflow run, with state, progress, timestamps, and metadata.

classes.name: WorkflowRunUpdate
classes.description: Atomic updates to a workflow run.

classes.name: WorkflowStep
classes.description: Individual steps within a workflow run.

classes.name: WorkflowStepFilters
classes.description: Filters for querying workflow steps.

classes.name: WorkflowStepLeaseOptions
classes.description: Configuration for leasing workflow steps.

classes.name: ExecutionNote
classes.description: Notes attached to workflow executions.

classes.name: Workflow
classes.description: Aggregated workflow info, including metrics and hierarchy.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Session-level aggregation and metadata for workflows.

classes.name: WorkflowExecutionFilters
classes.description: Filters for querying workflow executions.

classes.name: WorkflowRunFilters
classes.description: Filters for querying workflow runs.

classes.name: WorkflowFilters
classes.description: Filters for querying workflows.

classes.name: SessionFilters
classes.description: Filters for sessions.

classes.name: ReasonerPerformanceMetrics
classes.description: Performance data for reasoners.

classes.name: RecentExecutionItem
classes.description: Data for recent execution statistics.

classes.name: ReasonerExecutionHistory
classes.description: Paginated history of reasoner executions.

classes.name: ReasonerExecutionRecord
classes.description: Single execution record for reasoner history.

classes.name: WorkflowSummaryData
classes.description: Pre-aggregated data snapshot for workflows.

classes.name: WorkflowCleanupResult
classes.description: Result of cleaning up workflows, including deleted data and space freed.
